chunks: And Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who has a female slave, strips her, and looks at her body with lustful intent: does she become lawful for his father? And if his father does that, does she become lawful for his son?

He عليه السلام said: If he looks at her with lustful intent and looks at that of her which is unlawful for others to see, she does not become lawful for his son. And if the son does that, she does not become lawful for the father.

key_terms.نَظَرَ شَهْوَةٍ: a look of lust or sexual desire
key_terms.ٱلْجَارِيَةُ: a female slave owned by the man in this legal case

ai.seo_question: Does looking at a female slave with lust make her unlawful for a man's father or son?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a female slave and the effect of lustful looking upon marriage permissibility within the line of father and son. It states that when one of them looks at her with desire and at what is unlawful for others to see, she becomes unlawful for the other.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4435 - And it is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (as)

regarding a man who has a female slave, strips her, and looks at her body with lustful intent, whether she becomes unlawful for his father, and if the father does the same, whether she becomes unlawful for his son.

Imam (as) said: "If he looks at her with lustful intent and sees from her what is unlawful for others to see, she becomes unlawful for his son. And if the son does the same, she becomes unlawful for the father."
